title: Deterministic search with polynomial verifier coverage
claims: An arbitrary pinned polynomial-time verifier can be searched through a polynomial-size prefix of the reference Boolean-word enumeration. If the prefix contains a witness for every yes-input, the corresponding language belongs to P.
Languages with a polynomial-time verifier and a logarithmic-length certificate for each yes-input belong to P.
The exact P subset NP inclusion follows from pinned reference L010.
Every pinned polynomial-time verifier gives a P language when existential search is restricted to a fixed finite witness list.
In particular, a verifier with a fixed constant witness bound defines a language in P.

experiments.purpose: Run the pinned exact-statement checker when the reference checkout is available and otherwise report unavailability.
